messages:
liz_cs: Quick check — onboarding packet for Solstice (trial) shows latency SLO at 95th=220ms but customer asked for 150ms. Can we confirm what we promised in the contract?
omar_cs: I pulled the intake notes — they asked for <200ms during onboarding ramp, but the formal SLO in the MSA is 220ms.
ben_sales: FYI, during the sales call we said "low latency" and gave a soft expectation around 150ms — my bad for the ambiguity.
liz_cs: Ok — need to align comms before we send the onboarding dashboard. If legal/ops will only accept 220ms we need to be explicit about any credits for missed lower targets.
nina_sre: Current infra profile for Solstice is Dedicated-small (2xA10G). Median token latency is ~80ms, tails hit ~210ms during spikes. I can run a 24h trace to show distribution.
jordan_eng: Nina — can you include the 95/99 percentiles and the sequence length distribution? That helps customer expected cases.
nina_sre: Will do. ETA end of day.
liz_cs: Omar / Ben — we need a short note to share with customer: 1) what our contractual SLO is (220ms), 2) what we can operationally expect in onboarding, 3) how credits would be handled if we voluntarily commit to 150ms.
omar_cs: Drafting a one-pager now. Question: do we want to offer a one-time onboarding credit if we don't hit 150ms for the first 30 days?
ben_sales: Offering a one-time credit is reasonable but prefer it capped and tied to an enablement session (so they feel supported). e.g., credit = prorated month fee up to X, plus a 1-hour performance workshop.
enablement-bot: Reminder: enablement slot availability: Wed 10-11am, Thu 2-3pm next week. Reply with preferred slot to reserve.
liz_cs: Let's pick Wed 10 for the workshop. Ben to confirm with customer.
ben_sales: Confirmed w/ customer — Wed 10 works. I'll send calendar invite after we finalize the note.
jordan_eng: For the note, can we add a bullet on mitigation paths (warmup cache, prefix caching, lower quantization) that ops can enable quickly if tail latency spikes?
nina_sre: Yes — I'll include mitigation steps and a short playbook snippet. Example command to flush warmup cache: `curl -X POST https://ops-api/internal/warmup?model=redwood-v1`.
omar_cs: Draft ready: will attach the 24h traces and playbook. I'll also include a sample credits calculation: if 150ms target is missed for >20% of requests in a 30d window then a prorated credit = (monthly fee * 0.15). Open to adjustments.
liz_cs: Thanks — can you make the credit calc configurable so CS can tune per account? Add a line: "subject to legal signoff".
omar_cs: Yep. Sending draft in #customer-success-docs and attaching to this thread.
ben_sales: Once legal okays, I will cc procurement and route the amendment.
liz_cs: Great. Post-mortem: capture customer's feedback on latency docs so enablement can iterate. I'll add a quick Google Form to the follow-up invite.
ben_sales: +1. Also tagging jordan_eng to collect any quick perf tuning notes to include in the workshop slides.
jordan_eng: On it.
liz_cs: Closing loop — action items: nina generates traces + playbook (EOD), omar posts draft one-pager (in channel) and makes credit calc editable, ben confirms calendar invite, jordan supplies tuning bullets.
ben_sales: Marking as in-progress, will update this thread when invite sent. :thumbsup:
enablement-bot: Calendar event created: Solstice enablement — Wed 10-11am (link: https://meet.redwood.ai/solstice-enable).
